legal_provisions: IPC Section 468 (Forgery for purpose of cheating)
details.ncrb_crime_head: Cyber Financial Frauds (Category 11.2 - NCRB Crime in India)
details.summary: Multi-crore un-registered algorithmic trading syndicate defrauding victims across Maharashtra and Karnataka through bogus trading terminals and hawala cashouts.

details.complainant: Cyber Prevention Cell, Ministry of Home Affairs (I4C)
details.summary: Bulk provisioning of SIM cards using forged Aadhaar cards and selling active mule bank accounts on Telegram channels to cyber syndicates.

details.dataset_source: InLegalNER Court Exhibit & TRAI Telecom Mobility
details.transcript: Vikram, BKC Cyber cell ne notices issue kiye hain. Server hard drives ko format karke warehouse shift karo. Sunil advocate se bail application draft karvao.

details.dataset_source: InLegalNER Court Exhibit & TRAI Telecom Mobility
details.transcript: Sunil advocate ne confirm kiya session court main transit anticipatory bail lagayenge. Cash proceeds Dubai USDT desk ko send ho chuka hai.

details.text: Bail petition draft ready hai. Kal subah 10 baje Bombay High Court registry mein file hoga under Section 438 CrPC.
Noted bhai. Sabhi burner phones destroy kar diye hain. Hum Kempegowda airport corridor se exit plan ready rakh rahe hain.

details.narration: Conspiracy defense retainer and safehouse logistics payment
